title: Marquee over the tracks, and a range limited to the tracks you cross
goal: From the user on 2026-09-28: drag a box in empty timeline space to pick clips and parts of clips on the tracks it crosses, and Option-drag (or R, Final Cut's Range tool) to pick a stretch of time on just those tracks, then act on it the way a range on the ruler is acted on. Split from the range selection task, which built the whole-timeline range on the ruler.
notes: Split out of select-a-range-of-time-across-clips-and-tracks-a (2026-09-28). The ruler range is document.markedRangeMS (every unlocked track). A track-limited range needs its own state (range plus track ids) and track-scoped versions of liftStretch/extractStretch/putTransitionOnEveryCut(within:) in PhotonzCore (MarkedStretch.swift, RulerRange.swift). Piece-level multi-selection does not exist yet: selection is layers (multiSelectedLayerIDs) plus one selectedClipPieceIndex. Empty lane space: TimelineTrackRows.swift lanes.
acceptance: A drag that starts in empty timeline space draws a box and picks every clip it touches, on the tracks it crosses
Option-drag, or the R tool, picks a stretch of time on the crossed tracks only, drawn over those tracks alone
Delete, Shift-Delete, Cmd-T and the right-click actions act on that track-limited stretch and leave other tracks alone
Walk at Next defaults: two tracks, a marquee over one, then an Option-drag range on one track, Delete, check the other track is untouched

log.note: Pre-build review: (1) A drag on bare lane space scrubs today; Premiere and Final Cut both draw a marquee there, so a drag becomes the box and a click still moves the playhead (ruler and scrub bar keep scrubbing). (2) The model cuts a recording into PIECES of one layer, so a box over part of a cut recording must pick pieces, not the whole layer, or Delete would take the whole recording: whole clips go to the existing layer multi-selection (drag, delete all work), a single piece to the existing piece pick, and several pieces to a new piece pick. (3) A clip's own sound is drawn on an audio track but is the same layer: a box or range over only its sound row takes the clip (Premiere's linked selection). (4) R is Final Cut's Range tool and Premiere's Rate Stretch; the user named R, so R it is, only while the timeline has the keyboard. (5) No mock draws the marquee or a track range; the green band follows the ruler range already shipped. (6) A track range is selection state, not a document edit: it is not in undo, like a pick.

Built: core TrackRange.swift (layerIDs(onTracks:), marqueePicks, liftPicks/rippleDeletePicks, track-limited lift/extract/split/transitions; MarkedStretch + removeTime take onTracks/onlyLayers), TrackRangeTests (24). App: EditorState+TrackRange.swift (lane press/drag/release, pick rules, held range/pieces, menu rows), TimelineLaneMarquee gesture on bare lanes, Range tool (R, bar button), TimelineLaneBoxView draws the box and per-track band. Walk steps dragTracks + expectTimelinePick. marquee-and-track-range-walk green at Next defaults (11 real captures); 21 related walks + an-editing-session green. keys-copy-between-layers-walk fails, but that came from the ruler range commit (rotating check 20:19Z); filed as the-keys-copy-walk-moves-the-playhead-the-way-th.

Rough items from the audit kept here, not filed. None is broken, and each is a follow-on the user can raise from the audit: Shift to add to a box pick; dragging picked pieces as a group; Cmd-T and Split for box-picked pieces; the '<name> copy' naming, which comes from the existing Lift.

Shipped in 54f70028. A drag in empty track space draws a box that picks the clips it touches on the tracks it crosses, or only the pieces of a cut recording it touched. Option-drag, or R (Range tool, with a bar button), picks a stretch of time on the crossed tracks only, drawn over those tracks alone. Delete, Shift-Delete, Cmd-T and the right-click act on that stretch and leave other tracks alone. Verified with TrackRangeTests (24), full suite green (10,374), and marquee-and-track-range-walk at Next defaults with 11 real captures, plus 22 related walks.
